messages:
alex_w: Quick follow-up from today's incident — thanks everyone. Main action items: tighten RBAC, KMS key policy review, audit log retention, vuln triage backlog, tabletop in 2 weeks. I'll dump initial notes below.

maya_s: Thanks. can we get owners for each item? I'll take RBAC + small perms audit.

santiago_r: I'll own KMS policy review + rotation plan. Quick Q: do we want cross-project KMS keys or per-customer keys? leaning per-customer for isolation.

irene_k: I'll handle audit/logging — increase retention to 90d for auth events, enable alerting on missing logs. also add SPLUNK query: `index=redwood_auth | stats count by user, action` and a saved search for failed auths.

jamal_t: For vuln triage: I'll add the CVEs to backlog, assign severity. We should categorize: exploit path, customer exposure, PoC.dev

alex_w: Proposed smaller triage steps: 1) reproduce 2) PoC? 3) patch/mitigation 4) rollout verification. use label `sec-incident-2026-03`.

sec-bot: Incident channel created: #incident-2026-03-14; timeline doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INC/incident-2026-03-14

maya_s: RBAC checklist (short): - list service accounts w/ write perms - revoke stale perms - apply least-priv - add scheduled audit job (monthly)

santiago_r: KMS notes: - remove wildcard principals - set key policy: allow only service accounts and KMS admin role - enable key rotation every 90d - integrate with HSM via cloud-kms connector

irene_k: Audit logging changes I'll implement: - enable object-level logging for S3/GCS - create alert: 5 failed auths in 1m - log retention policy update via infra-as-code (Terraform)

jamal_t: Vulnerability triage process: add label + severity + mitigation ETA. I'll run exploitability matrix and tag accordingly. Will also link to any vendor advisories.

alex_w: Risk acceptance: if any item is >P2 and >48h ETA, we must escalate to Eng leads and CS for customer comms.

maya_s: Tabletop: propose 2026-03-28 10:00 PST. 45 min. invite: eng-sre, eng-security, product ops, oncall. agenda: detection->containment->comm->postmortem & action assignment

santiago_r: +1 for tabletop. I'll prepare KMS playbook snippet. Example snippet I'll add to the playbook:
```
# KMS key rotation check
aws kms describe-key --key-id alias/redwood-app-key
# verify rotationEnabled == true
```

irene_k: I'll prepare audit log playbook and sample alert runbook. attaching quick alert query: `index=redwood_auth sourcetype=auth_logs | where action=="failed_login" | stats count by user`

jamal_t: I'll draft vuln triage template and share in #eng-security. Suggest columns: id, cve, affected-svc, exploitability, customer-impact, mit-eta, owner.

alex_w: ok. action owners: RBAC: maya_s, KMS: santiago_r, Audit: irene_k, Vuln triage: jamal_t, Tabletop org: alex_w. Please update tickets by EOD Friday.

maya_s: updating tickets now. cc @here :thumbsup: 

santiago_r: pushed PR for KMS policy draft: gitlab.com/redwood/infra/-/merge_requests/451  — please review.

irene_k: audit retention PR: gitlab.com/redwood/infra/-/merge_requests/452

jamal_t: vuln triage board link: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/SEC?filter=incident-2026-03  (I'll add initial issues tonight)

alex_w: thanks everyone — we'll reconvene after tabletop. Closing thread for now.
